Predicted: Zero cosmological expansion inside virialized galaxy clusters

Falsification_Criterion: Precision astrometric monitoring finding cosmological-rate expansion of proper separations between member galaxies inside a virialized cluster, a non-zero signal at the ~H₀ × d level, would falsify the λ-suppression mechanism.

Observable: Galaxies at the centers of rich clusters show a systematic gravitational redshift offset Δz ~ 10⁻⁵ relative to outskirts; the SCT-specific extension is a frame-tree mass-dependent scaling testable with DESI's >1000 cluster sample. Status note (2026 review): cluster gravitational redshift (~3-5 x 10^-5) is detected repeatedly but each result is only ~2-3.5 sigma (Wojtak 2011; Mpetha 2021; Marulli 2023), is systematics-limited (Kaiser 2013), and does not yet separate GR from f(R)/MOND.
Predicted: Cluster gravitational redshift stratification at the 10⁻⁵ level
Falsification_Criterion: DESI spectroscopic analysis of >1000 galaxy clusters finding no systematic redshift stratification between centers and outskirts at the 10⁻⁵ level after peculiar velocity control, OR the stratification existing but not scaling with cluster potential depth as predicted by the frame-tree mass relation.

Observable: Co-rotating satellite planes appear around all adequately sampled host galaxies. The joint LambdaCDM tension for the observed systems (Milky Way VPOS, Andromeda GPoA, Centaurus A) is at the ~10^-5 to 10^-6 level - a genuine few-sigma anomaly under a proper joint statistic, not a naive product of per-system probabilities. Status note (2026 review): the earlier ~2 x 10^-14 figure was an invalid naive product of a-posteriori-selected per-system p-values (~8 orders too extreme; Pawlowski 2018); the planes are real but not universal and their persistence is contested as possibly transient (Sawala 2023).
Predicted: Co-rotating satellite-galaxy planes around all adequately sampled host galaxies
Falsification_Criterion: A systematic survey of ≥20 adequately sampled host galaxies finding co-rotation frequencies comparable to the ΛCDM prediction (~0.5%), rather than the observed ~100%.

Status note (2026 review): the one-in-a-million significance applies to the full-redshift sample; the high-z (z>1.3) subsample is only ~2 sigma.
Predicted: BCG–cluster shape alignment fully in place at z > 1.3
Falsification_Criterion: Re-analysis of West et al. (2017) cluster sample with refined BCG-shape estimators finding alignment at z > 1.3 weaker than at z = 0, consistent with gradual tidal assembly rather than formation-epoch imprinting.

Falsification_Criterion: A precision measurement of spatial variation in η_B across cosmological scales incompatible with geometric production from spatially varying collision impact parameters; OR definitive laboratory detection of leptogenesis or baryogenesis through mechanisms inconsistent with the sphaleron + geometric CP scenario.

Predicted: GGSL substructure lensing excess in massive clusters
Falsification_Criterion: Increasing CDM concentration uniformly in ΛCDM simulations fully resolving the GGSL excess at all radii and masses, demonstrating that the excess is an artifact of CDM concentration, not external superposition.

Observable: Overmassive black holes at z > 7 with BH-to-stellar mass ratios 10–1000× above the local Magorrian relation are predicted by direct-collapse BH seeds from head-on collision geometry: M_seed = f_BH × α_th × f_b,cosmic × μ, spanning 10⁷–10⁹ M☉ for M₁ = M₂ = 10¹²–10¹⁴ M☉. Falsification_Criterion: Detection of a complete z > 7 BH mass census showing all can be explained by Eddington-limited accretion from Population III stellar seeds formed at z < 30, no residual overabundance requiring M_seed > 10⁶ M☉.

Predicted: Hubble tension at ~5σ
Dataset: Dark Energy, Hubble Tension, and Expansion
Falsification_Criterion: The Hubble tension being resolved by a mechanism that requires zero environmental Λ variation, such as early dark energy acting uniformly across all environments, while simultaneously ruling out a ~9% local Λ_eff enhancement.

Falsification_Criterion: Future surveys showing these structures are statistical projection effects or selection-function artifacts, with no physical overdensity at gigaparsec scales above ΛCDM expectations.

Predicted: DESI 2024 evolving dark energy hint (w₀ > −1, w_a < 0)
Dataset: Dark Energy, Hubble Tension, and Expansion
Falsification_Criterion: Precision measurement of w(z) = −1.000 ± 0.005 confirmed constant across all redshifts and all survey environments at high significance; OR demonstration that inter-survey w scatter is consistent with noise, not environmental Λ_eff variation.

Observable: Confirmed galaxies with M_* > 10⁸ M☉ continue to appear at z > 14 following a power-law (not exponential) decline in comoving number density, contradicting the ΛCDM exponential suppression at z > 12. Status corrected from [CONFIRMED] to [PENDING]: only the existence of two massive z ≈ 14 systems is confirmed; the discriminating power-law-vs-exponential test requires a z > 14 statistical sample not yet available, so the distinguishing claim is future work.
Predicted: JWST z > 14 massive galaxies and morphological maturity at high redshift
Falsification_Criterion: All JWST spectroscopic programs targeting z > 14 finding zero galaxies with M_* > 10⁸ M☉, consistent with ΛCDM exponential suppression.

Observable: The protocluster SPT2349-56 (z = 4.3, the one tSZ-detected high-z system to date) shows ICM thermal energy ~5-14x above the virial expectation, the 'born-hot' ICM, correlated with elevated stellar mass, high disk fraction, and overmassive central BHs. Predicted: Born-hot ICM at z = 4.3 protocluster SPT2349-56
Falsification_Criterion: A survey of ≥10 protoclusters at z > 3 showing all systems with E_therm/E_vir following the TNG-Cluster median; OR ICM thermal excess found uncorrelated with stellar mass excess, disk fraction, and BH mass.

The J ∝ M × v_rel scaling must hold at all observed redshifts. Predicted: Galaxy cluster spin signal, 360–693 km/s scaling with mass
Falsification_Criterion: Cluster spin surveys at z = 0.5–1.5 finding J ∝ M × v_rel scaling absent or strongly redshift-dependent, consistent with gradual tidal torque accumulation.

Next filament samples will confirm this scaling. Status note (2026 review): individual-filament rotation (~110 km/s) is tentative - ~2-3 sigma in a single 15 Mpc filament (Tudorache 2025), building on the stacked 'possible evidence' of Wang 2021.

Falsification_Criterion: Systematic MeerKAT/SKA survey of ≥50 filaments finding bulk rotation velocities consistent with IllustrisTNG predictions (i.e., amplitude within simulation uncertainty) and spin-axis alignment no stronger than simulations predict.

Status note (2026 review): the mass dependence is confirmed (van Uitert and Joachimi 2017); the persistence scale is ~100 h^-1 Mpc, not 200-300 Mpc.
Predicted: Cluster major-axis correlation extending to 200–300 Mpc
Falsification_Criterion: CMB-S4 cluster catalogs at z > 1.5 showing alignment amplitude decreasing with redshift, or ellipticity evolution inconsistent with e ≈ 0.33 + 0.05z at >3σ.

(The established result is that the CMB dipole and the quasar number-count dipole point the same way - see prediction 23.)
Predicted: CMB dipole perpendicular to large-scale angular-momentum axis (P64)
Falsification_Criterion: Dedicated analysis finding the CMB dipole direction aligned with (not perpendicular to) the large-scale AM coherence axis at >3σ. (Planck CMB dipole reconstruction combined with SKA full-sky polarimetric jet axis maps provides the decisive joint test).

Falsification_Criterion: Independent reanalysis dissolving the tracer-dependent dipole pattern into a single kinematic dipole consistent across all tracers in direction and amplitude; or the amplitude excesses reduced below 2 σ by demonstrated systematics across all catalogs simultaneously.

Falsification_Criterion: Combined DES+HSC+KiDS S₈ outside [0.722, 0.812] (the ±3 σ window centered on the corrected prediction S₈ = 0.767 ± 0.015) at high confidence; or the redshift evolution of the inferred amplitude failing to follow the coherence growth A(z) (companion to ledger #40).
